NORTH FAMBRIDGE, CHELMSFORD

Do you have an electrical background and enjoy helping customers understand products and solve technical problems?

Get Recruited is recruiting on behalf of an established engineering business for a Technical Customer Service Advisor to join its small, friendly team. You'll use your electrical knowledge to answer technical enquiries, support customers and keep their orders moving.

- Answer questions about availability, order progress and deliveries, coordinating with colleagues to resolve issues.

- Alternatively, an electrical engineering background with experience explaining technical information to customers.
- A sound understanding of electrical components and how they function within a circuit.
- Confident reading electrical diagrams and technical datasheets, including supply voltages, relay contacts and connection arrangements.
- Clear communication skills, patience and a methodical approach to investigating customer problems.
- Strong attention to detail when processing orders, recording information and following up enquiries.
- As a Technical Customer Service Advisor, you'll be comfortable balancing technical enquiries, order processing and practical tasks within a small team.
- A relevant technical qualification is desirable, ideally in electrical or electronic engineering.
- Experience with relays, control panels or industrial automation products would be advantageous.

A Technical Support Advisor will bring experience investigating product questions; a Customer Service Executive will need the electrical knowledge to handle those conversations confidently.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: We reserve the right to close the advertisement before the closing date, if we so choose. We have a vacancy within our medical reception team. We are looking for a candidate who has some experience with administration or reception duties, preferably in a healthcare setting, although we will consider applicants from other backgrounds. The job entails greeting patients at reception in person, over the phone, supporting GPs in care navigation, booking and cancelling appointments and a range of other administrative duties. We are looking for somebody with a friendly and approachable personality whilst ensuring professionalism at all times. We want our practice to be a welcoming place for patients and our reception team are key in providing our front of house services. Previous GP practice experience is not essential as training will be given, however, we are looking for a can-do approach and somebody who will fit in to friendly and likeable team. Patient care is at the heart of what we do and we want to provide the best possible service for them. Being a 'people' person and ability to work in a fast-paced environment is essential. Politeness, care and compassion are essential attributes to be successful within the role. Medical Receptionist duties include ability to learn our clinical system, answering telephones, booking appointments via the online rota, being IT literate, treating people with dignity and respect. Successful candidates will also be provided with further training on clinical correspondence (workflow) and there will be an expectation that some of this work forms part of the role.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are looking for a Medical Receptionist to join our friendly team in providing a high standard of service to our patients. Excellent customer service skills are vital for this role. We expect the successful candidate to be able to work well as part of a team and perform effectively under pressure. You will need to be a team player and be able to work in a fast-paced environment. This position is for maternity cover, with the view to becoming permanent for the right candidate. Desirable experience in general practice but not essential for the right person. The role includes: -Handling telephone calls -Digital enquiries from patients including working closely with our Triage Doctor -Care navigation -Administrative duties -Registration processing

title: Receptionist / Care Navigator
description: Longfield Medical Centre has an opportunity for an enthusiastic and proactive receptionist to join our team on apart-time basis, for 22.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 2.00pm - 6.30pm . The receptionist plays a pivotal role in the experience of patients at our practice, helping them to access the right services and dealing with their queries face-to-face, online and by telephone. The main responsibilities of the role include: Greeting and directing all patients. Making appointments. Answering queries and complaints from patients and outside agencies, signposting to the appropriate staff member as appropriate. Accepting, issuing and handing out letters, completed forms, specimen bottles, etc. Advising patients of practice procedures. Registering new patients. Accurately maintaining patient database and records, photocopying, filing and scanning. If you would like to find out more information about this role, please do not hesitate to get in contact with us.
